articles.title: Counting the days, revisited

My old code wasn't as good as it could have been, and I recently learned from Ben Joffe that my approach was missing several tricks. The main idea behind Julian years Gregorian correction the month pattern the epoch domains and ranges leap year test length of month the main idea is to adjust the date counts so they align with a repeating 5-month pattern in the calendar. articles.title: Dithered QR codes
articles.summary: Dithered QR codes involve modifying data modules in a QR code to make them look distinctive and robust against scanning errors. This is achieved by shrinking the data modules, which allows for a fair amount of flexibility before the code becomes unscannable. The process involves dividing each pixel into a three-by-three grid and storing the middle one as the data module, while the others are used for a photo. Dithering techniques such as Floyd-Steinberg dithering can be applied to improve the image quality, but error diffusion is also an important aspect of making QR codes more robust against scanning errors.
